'''Gibbit birds''' were avian creatures native to [[Dathomir]]. Gibbit birds were symbiotic to the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]. The rancor allowed the gibbit bird to roam freely in its [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]], where the bird cleaned its [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] by picking out stuck pieces of [[Bone/Legends|bones]] and flesh. This helped the rancor's teeth remain sharp and healthy, and allowed the gibbit bird to obtain food of its own.
